metadata.description: Vios plugins for F&B clients: shared rules, brand strategy (Stage 1), customer journey (Stages 2-4), marketing operations. Enable vios-core first.

plugins.name: vios-core
plugins.description: Shared rules every Vios plugin loads: guardrails, BE lens, non-verbal lens, the filter test, with Part III sections 3.1, 3.2 and 3.4 as references. Enable first.

plugins.name: vios-brand
plugins.description: Stage 1 end to end: diagnosis, messages and story, persona, name and tagline, brand book. Requires vios-core.

plugins.name: vios-journey
plugins.description: Stages 2 to 4: journey map, journey design, training programme. Requires vios-core and vios-brand.

plugins.name: vios-engage
plugins.description: The engagement wrapper: intake, proposal, workspace setup, harvest. Parts IV and V. Requires vios-core.

plugins.name: vios-marketing
plugins.description: Monthly operations: calendar, copy, video, QA, ads, report. Requires vios-core.
